name: Swazi Candles Centre (Malkerns Valley)
subtitle: A craft complex in the Malkerns Valley where artisans make candles, woodcarvings, beadwork and textiles.

parts.text: A craft complex in the Malkerns Valley where artisans make candles, woodcarvings, beadwork and textiles. It also holds shops, a bookshop and the Yebo! Art Gallery.
